title: Continual fire-making by Hominins at Gesher Benot Ya‘aqov, Israel
version: Quaternary Science Reviews 27 (2008), 1733–1739. Published author copy inspected via Academia.edu.
lineage: Publisher preview and Academia.edu transcription of the author's personal copy of the published article. The earlier flint counts and hearth interpretation are part of the same Gesher research lineage as the 2022 fish study.

passages.note: Layer II-6 lists eight horizons because L4b is listed separately. Burnt flint microartifact counts for L2, L3 and L6 are 563, 877 and 251.

passages.quote: Burned flint items occur in all eight levels of Layer II-6 (Table 1).
passages.note: The burnt microartifacts cluster in successive horizons. Burnt and unburnt flint distributions are distinctly separated in L2 and nearly overlap in L6.
The author evaluates natural burning and interprets the concentrations as traces of hominin hearths. Repeated use does not identify how fire was acquired.
